description: Redevelopment of the Former Salisbury Road Depot site consisting of the erection of a 3 storey residential building, and a part 3 and 5 storey residential building to provide 103 affordable residential flats, private and communal residential amenity space, parking provision (for 78 cars and 96 cycles), servicing and vehicular access from Salisbury Road, renewable energy generation equipment, and the provision of roof mounted telecommunications equipment to replace the existing telecommunications mast on the Endsleigh Industrial Estate (linked with the approved application P/2009/3160) for the redevelopment of the Former Featherstone Primary School to provide 146 private residential flats, provision of private and communal residential amenity space, parking provision (for 87 cars and 146 cycles), servicing and vehicular access from Featherstone Road and installation of renewable energy generation equipment) (Consultation from the London Borough of Ealing)
